annotations.title: Explain one route, screen or dependency

description: Everything about one row of the Performance page, to answer 'why is this slow?': count, error rate, p50 to p99 and the change against the window before; where the time goes inside each request (database, HTTP and model calls, and the backend routes a screen waited on); what the slowest 10% have that the rest don't (release, status, device…) and which inner spans grow most in them; who calls a dependency; per-release numbers; sample traces (slowest, typical, fastest, failed: open them with get_trace); and the open issues on that route. op is like http.server, ui.load, ui.pageload, http.client, db, gen_ai, task; route is the route, screen, page, host or table as get_performance_overview lists it.

environment.description: Like production. Default: production when the app has it, else its busiest non-development one. 'all' for every environment.

from.description: An ISO time, or how long ago: 30m, 24h, 7d

range.description: Window: 1h, 24h, 7d, 14d, 30d or 90d (default 24h). Ignored when from is given.

route.description: The row's route, screen, page, host or table

service.description: Only this service, like house-ai-api or the app's bundle id

source.description: backend (servers), frontend (app and web), or all (default)

to.description: An ISO time, or how long ago (default now)

name: get_endpoint_summary
